responsibility: This awk generator postprocesses GCC’s pass pipeline description in passes.def into pass-instances.def by assigning stable instance numbers to every NEXT_PASS occurrence and by applying pass-splicing directives such as INSERT_PASS_AFTER, INSERT_PASS_BEFORE, and REPLACE_PASS. It tracks pass occurrence counts and source-line positions, rewrites the pipeline macros to carry explicit instance indices (and preserved pass arguments), and emits the final numbered pass schedule used by later pass-manager construction code.
